The one coupled M1 appropriately reconciles advertised methods, projection inventory, validator dispatch, CLI spec withdrawal and exclusive tests before shipping. No separate feature/proof contract or proof map is consumed. Historical routing, generic aliases, other location kinds and record safety remain outside retirement.

Unknown protective value blocks deletion, group-level removal accounting and actual discovery are required, and coherent rollback names the recoverable baseline while preserving customer and historical bytes. This avoids both automatic deletion by filename and unnecessary per-test ledgers.

All nine named command paths exist, --check flags exist, and native boundary and packaging entrypoints collect their actual groups. No future command execution is claimed.

AUTH-SH-005 allocation correctly distinguishes unsupported and template requests from separately authorized source adoption, records independent proposed-decision observations and disclaims universal agent compliance. However, the rewritten compact method retains a distinct semantic obligation under DES-SR-23 and Design building-block content: four-question scan, eight dimensions, actual interactions and upstream-gap ownership. TG-METHOD only concretely allocates output/adoption comparison; inventory/parity and phrase checks cannot demonstrate preserved reasoning. The recorded plan-local finding requires this missing proof allocation.

Closeout is sound: selected full local integration with honest reuse, release communication without publication authority, independent M1 review, fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain separate. Exact committed PR selection/current-record snapshot and hosted/local limits are allocated. No other material allocation or authority gap was identified.
summary: The coupled retirement sequence and most proof allocations are adequate; explicitly allocate semantic preservation assessment for the rewritten compact boundary method before implementation.
